(17)pha gcig bla ma dri med 'od zer dang*/dbyer med lung rtogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag des/'di tsam ma yin tshe rab thams cad du/don brgyud dgongs pa'i ba

tei:div.tei:p: (17)pha gcig bla ma dri med 'od zer dang*/ dbyer med lung rtogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag des/ 'di tsam ma yin tshe rab thams cad du/ don brgyud dgongs pa'i byin rlabs snying la rtsol/ rdo rje'i mchod la da dung gros gcig 'debs/ dal 'byor rin chen snying po thob dus 'dir/ spro dgas chos la 'bad par ma byas na/ rnam g.yengs 'du 'ji'i yeng bar 'dug gam som/ mi rtag mi brtan sgyu ma'i grong khyer la/ snying nas mi rtag blo sna ma bstungs na/ rtag 'jin phyi tshis yong bar 'dug gam som/ khams gsum mtho dman sdug bsngal rang bzhin la/ rang bzhin mthong ba'i nges 'byung ma bskyed na/ lam la zhugs los yong bar 'dug gam som/ las 'bras rten 'brel bslu ba med pa la/ snying nas yid ches dad pa ma skye na/ chos pa bzang los yong bar 'dug gam som/ gzhan yang dus ngan snyigs ma'i (18)'gro ba la/ blo gtad mi 'dug bslu ba'i sgyu 'phrul ngom/ ci smras mi bden rdzun gyi bslu brid mkhan/ kho dang bstun na mi dge sna tshogs 'phel/ des na rang gi rang la gros gdab ran/ rang tshugs 'jin pa kho bo'i snying gtam lags/ 'jig rten bya ba ji ltar bzang na yang*/ yod yod 'dra ste don la med nges yin/ des na tshe 'di'i snang shes rgyab tu bor/ thar pa dam pa'i chos la 'bad par rigs/ rang mgo nyi ma chos kyis ma bton na/ mthun 'jug mang pos phan pa gda'am ltos/ rang nyid rang gis thar lam ma btsud na/ gzhan dag su yi dbang gis ji ltar bgyi/ khyod kyis mthong dang thos pa'i mi dag la/ thar pa'i lam la phyogs pa 'dug gam ltos/ 'jig rten tshe 'di'i bya ba bsgrub pa la/ 'di dang phyi ma phan pa mi gda' bas/ 'khor bas bya ba shar shir zin dus med/ 'di la snying nas snying po 'dug gam som/ kho bos dang po mtshan ldan (19)bla ma brten/ bar du thos bsam mig gis rdul phyis nas/ da lta chos nyid mnyam par rol pa'i yul/ bsgom pa'i gom stabs gcig gis bsgrod nas su/

'od gsal gsang chen snying po'i pho brang rtser/ rgya grol lhun 'byams yang pa'i ngang du mnal/ srid chos mi rtag sgyu ma'i rol mo shar/ yod med yin min snang stong zung du chud/ kun mkhyen bla ma'i dgongs pa rtog gam snyam/ rig 'jin gong ma'i rjes su phyin pa snyams/ chos nyid rig pa mngon sum thong ba 'di/ kun mkhyen bla ma'i drin las gzhan dag su/ 'khrul pa'i mun pa nang nas dwangs ba'i tshe/ nyon mongs rnam rtog gar song cha med bor/ chos nyid gnyug ma'i rgyal khab khas len bral/ da ni su la'ang dri bar mi bya'o/ zhes gleng nas nyid kyi da dung yang tshig bdun gsol 'debs ci 'grub re la 'bod/ blo kha ma yengs/ sdug (20)ma 'ur/ rang tshod rang gis zungs/ sna thag gzhan la ma gtad/ rang thag rang gis chod/ gzhan gyi ci zer yang tig tig med/
zhes dben pa'i yang khrod ljon pa lung nas 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i rnal 'byor pa kun bzang pad+ma'i rig 'jin 'od gsalal rin chen snying po las 'brel rtsal zhes pas gang shar du spring ba'o//
